community_cards_button_check.name: community_cards_button_check
community_cards_button_check.value: ("community_cards"."button_label" IS NULL AND "community_cards"."button_target" IS NULL) OR (length("community_cards"."button_label") BETWEEN 1 AND 30 AND ("community_cards"."button_target" IN ('tab:topics', 'tab:polls', 'tab:schedule', 'tab:about', 'tab:community') OR ("community_cards"."button_target" LIKE 'https://_%' AND length("community_cards"."button_target") <= 500)))

content_reports_resolution_check.name: content_reports_resolution_check
content_reports_resolution_check.value: ("content_reports"."status" = 'open' AND "content_reports"."resolved_at" IS NULL) OR ("content_reports"."status" <> 'open' AND "content_reports"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL)

entries_options_check.name: entries_options_check
entries_options_check.value: json_valid("entries"."options") AND json_type("entries"."options") = 'array' AND (("entries"."kind" = 'topic' AND json_array_length("entries"."options") = 0) OR ("entries"."kind" = 'choice' AND json_array_length("entries"."options") BETWEEN 2 AND 6) OR ("entries"."kind" = 'binary' AND "entries"."options" = '["Yes","No"]'))

entry_mash_window_check.name: entry_mash_window_check
entry_mash_window_check.value: "entry_mash"."ends_at" IS NULL OR ("entry_mash"."starts_at" IS NOT NULL AND "entry_mash"."ends_at" > "entry_mash"."starts_at")

overlay_state_air_check.name: overlay_state_air_check
overlay_state_air_check.value: json_valid("overlay_state"."air") AND json_type("overlay_state"."air") = 'object' AND json_extract("overlay_state"."air", '$.type') IN ('auto', 'poll', 'topic', 'next', 'message', 'card', 'support', 'hidden') AND length("overlay_state"."air") <= 200

overlay_state_preview_check.name: overlay_state_preview_check
overlay_state_preview_check.value: json_valid("overlay_state"."preview") AND json_type("overlay_state"."preview") = 'object' AND json_extract("overlay_state"."preview", '$.type') IN ('auto', 'poll', 'topic', 'next', 'message', 'card', 'support', 'hidden') AND length("overlay_state"."preview") <= 200

stream_events_vod_check.name: stream_events_vod_check
stream_events_vod_check.value: "stream_events"."vod_url" IS NULL OR ("stream_events"."vod_url" LIKE 'https://_%' AND length("stream_events"."vod_url") <= 500)

stream_events_series_check.name: stream_events_series_check
stream_events_series_check.value: ("stream_events"."series_id" IS NULL AND "stream_events"."repeat_days" = 0) OR ("stream_events"."series_id" IS NOT NULL AND "stream_events"."repeat_days" > 0)

streamer_applications_review_check.name: streamer_applications_review_check
streamer_applications_review_check.value: ("streamer_applications"."status" = 'pending' AND "streamer_applications"."reviewed_at" IS NULL) OR ("streamer_applications"."status" <> 'pending' AND "streamer_applications"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL)

streamer_links_label_check.name: streamer_links_label_check
streamer_links_label_check.value: "streamer_links"."label" IS NULL OR length("streamer_links"."label") BETWEEN 1 AND 30

streamers_handle_check.name: streamers_handle_check
streamers_handle_check.value: length("streamers"."handle") BETWEEN 3 AND 30 AND "streamers"."handle" NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9_]*'
